headline: Khulna: Man shot dead 50 days after son's murder
summary: Akhtar Dhali was shot by unidentified gunmen in Rupsa Upazila, just 50 days after his son, Joy Dhali, was killed in a similar attack.
details: Akhtar Dhali was shot dead by unidentified gunmen on Monday evening in Durjanimahol village of Aichgati Union, Rupsa Upazila, Khulna.
The victim was sitting in front of his house around 6:45 PM when the attackers arrived, shot him, and quickly fled the scene.
Local residents rescued him and rushed him to Khulna Medical College Hospital, where the duty doctor declared him dead.
This tragedy follows the murder of his son, Joy Dhali, who was shot and hacked to death by gunmen on August 15.
Senior police officials have visited the crime scene and are investigating the motive and the identity of the attackers.
Police confirmed that they are looking into why and who carried out the shooting.
caption:
A father was shot dead in Khulna just 50 days after his son was murdered.

Akhtar Dhali was shot dead by unidentified gunmen on Monday evening in Durjanimahol village of Aichgati Union, Rupsa Upazila, Khulna.

The victim was sitting in front of his house around 6:45 PM when the attackers arrived, shot him, and quickly fled the scene.

Local residents rescued him and rushed him to Khulna Medical College Hospital, where the duty doctor declared him dead.

This tragedy follows the murder of his son, Joy Dhali, who was shot and hacked to death by gunmen on August 15.

Senior police officials have visited the crime scene and are investigating the motive and the identity of the attackers.

Police confirmed that they are looking into why and who carried out the shooting.

#Khulna #Bangladesh #CrimeNews #Justice #Rupsa

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Durga Puja: [[Shops and malls can stay open until 10pm]]
headline: Durga Puja: Shops and malls can stay open until 10pm
summary: The government has extended shopping hours by two extra hours to facilitate Puja shopping across Bangladesh until October 22.
details: The government has announced that shops, markets, and shopping centres across Bangladesh can remain open for two additional hours ahead of Durga Puja.
According to the Power Division, businesses are now permitted to operate from 11am to 10pm until October 22.
The previous schedule, which limited operations from 11am to 8pm, will return on October 23.
The Power Division has notified all city corporation mayors, divisional commissioners, deputy commissioners, and shop owners' associations.
The government had previously reduced shop hours to 8pm in August to save electricity and improve power management during an energy crisis.
Throughout the year, shopping hours have been fluctuated several times, including temporary relaxations for Eid-ul-Azha and stricter limits during other periods.
caption:
Shopping hours extended! 🛍️ Shops and malls across Bangladesh can now stay open until 10pm for Durga Puja shopping.

The government has announced that shops, markets, and shopping centres across Bangladesh can remain open for two additional hours ahead of Durga Puja.

According to the Power Division, businesses are now permitted to operate from 11am to 10pm until October 22.

The previous schedule, which limited operations from 11am to 8pm, will return on October 23.

The Power Division has notified all city corporation mayors, divisional commissioners, deputy commissioners, and shop owners' associations.

The government had previously reduced shop hours to 8pm in August to save electricity and improve power management during an energy crisis.

Throughout the year, shopping hours have been fluctuated several times, including temporary relaxations for Eid-ul-Azha and stricter limits during other periods.

#Bangladesh #DurgaPuja #Shopping #Dhaka #News

Source: Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo
